verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Framer publishes an llms.txt at framer.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200). That file indexes markdown (?md) versions of Framer pages, including developer and agent docs, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. Missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence of agents consuming these docs well, documentation of how far the ?md coverage extends (the help/.md probe returned 404), and any llms-full.txt or dedicated agent-docs guidance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://www.framer.com/llms.txt # Framer
